What to understand at MT14

Collected stone
A stone you have found. Collection alone is not the same as completing its unlock requirements.
Infinity Board
The place to inspect your stone progress and the conditions still missing. Use its current wording when older guides disagree.
90-combination coverage
Infinity progress across 15 regions and six difficulties. This is a broader acceleration project than the 15-distinct-region promotion objective.

What you are working toward

  • The supplied research describes Infinity 25, all 15 regions and Dr. Cubical’s discovery, associated with unlocking all ten stones. Confirm the current Headquarters wording.
  • Use the Infinity Board to track each stone’s collection, building task and shared requirements separately.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Finish the missing regions first

    Reach Infinity on each still-uncompleted region with a reliable blueprint. Record the regional objective separately from progress on additional difficulties. Improving 90 combinations may help later acceleration, but do not confuse it with the basic 15-region checklist. [S02] [S11]

  2. Choose a favorable region for Infinity 25

    Use your strongest sustainable Infinity build and support it through relevant Grid and Anvil purchases. Diagnose failed pushes before spending: if the problem is survival, more acceleration can simply reach the failure faster. [S09]

  3. Collect and unlock stones deliberately

    Consult the stone planning table below, then read the actual Infinity Board requirements. The supplied research describes non-Neutral collection through appropriately disabled enemies of the associated element at Infinity or beyond. Check the exact condition for each stone rather than assuming visiting its region is sufficient. [S09]

  4. Work on building conditions in parallel

    Shipments, Factory construction and Laboratory progression can take time. Start the conditions you can satisfy while improving the remaining regional records. Revisit the Board after each milestone to confirm that it counts. [S09]

  5. Complete the final promotion checklist

    Confirm depth, region count, module objectives and discovery independently in Headquarters. A collected stone, an unlocked stone and a charged stone are different states; do not substitute one for another when checking a requirement. [S02] [S09]

If you are stuck

I own every stone but the discovery is incomplete

Inspect unlock conditions on the Board. Owning the icons is not proof that the building and shared requirements are complete.

Two guides give different essence requirements

Use the current Board. The supplied research explicitly flags disagreement between older sources.

Infinity Stone planning table

These are the collection locations and building conditions reported in the supplied research. Use them to plan, then verify each condition on the current Infinity Board. A region name alone is not the complete drop condition. [S09]

StoneCollection routeReported building condition
NeutralDisable Neutral at Era 1M+Neutral Museum boost of at least 10×
EarthUnderground (R4)Mine depth at least 100,000
FireVolcano (R5)A tier-8 or higher Boiler in Factory
AirHigh Mountain (R6)10 billion Trading Post crates
NatureJungle (R7)Total Beacon tier at least 100
ElectricityMetallic Ruins (R8)Maximum Power Plant power at least 100 million
WaterOcean (R10)At least 100 Shipyard shipments
DarknessDark Realm (R12)At least 12 maximized Headquarters servers
LightHeaven (R13)At least 1,000 Arcade coins
UniversalUniverse (R14)Defeat one tier-3 boss or two tier-2 bosses

The supplied wiki summary also reports shared requirements of three Laboratory experiment prestiges and 250 elemental essence for applicable stones. It explicitly notes conflicting older values. Check those shared conditions separately on the Board rather than treating the table as a complete or freshly verified unlock checklist. [S09]

Ready to move on?

  • The required Infinity depth and all distinct regions are recorded.
  • Each stone has the state requested by the discovery objective.
  • Headquarters confirms every MT15 objective.
After the promotion

MT15 opens the final-boss stage. Stone activation and charging still matter; the promotion itself is not the entire preparation for the fight. [S02] [S09]
